title: India's Big Push for EV Charging: Powering Your Electric Ride
description: India is rapidly expanding its network of public electric vehicle (EV) charging stations across the country. This push is driven by government targets and lar.

faq.q: How much does it cost to charge an EV at a public station?
faq.a: The cost varies, but it's typically charged per unit of electricity (kWh). Rates can range from ₹15 to ₹25 per kWh for fast charging, depending on the operator and location.

faq.q: How long does it take to fully charge an EV?
faq.a: This depends heavily on the EV's battery size and the charger type. A small electric scooter might fully charge in 3-4 hours on an AC charger, while a large electric car could take 8-10 hours on AC, but only 30-60 minutes for an 80% charge on a DC fast charger.

faq.q: Are there enough charging stations on highways?
faq.a: The government and private players are actively focusing on setting up charging stations along national highways and expressways to support inter-city EV travel. While still growing, the network is rapidly improving.

faq.q: Can I charge any electric vehicle at any public station?
faq.a: Most public charging stations are designed to be compatible with common EV models sold in India, offering multiple connector types. However, it's always good to check the app for specific connector availability before visiting.
